# Visionary Path Services

> Guiding Dreams, Financing Futures. Pan-India premier education loan advisory providing 100% free guidance to students and parents for higher education in India and overseas.

## Organization Details
- **Organization Name:** Visionary Path Services
- **Official Website:** https://www.visionarypathservices.com
- **Helpline Phone:** +91 9063703038
- **WhatsApp Support:** +91 8150949070 (https://wa.me/918150949070)
- **Official Email:** Visionarypathservises@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- **Geographic Coverage:** Pan-India student and parent advisory support
- **Service Fee:** 100% Free guidance (Zero hidden fees, zero commission charged from students/parents)
- **Regulatory Status:** Independent loan advisory and lender-matching facilitator. VPS is not a bank, NBFC, or direct credit provider. All sanctions and disbursements are issued at the sole discretion of RBI-regulated partner institutions.

## Core Advisory Services
- [Abroad Education Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/abroad-loans.html): Secured and non-collateral loan options up to ₹2 Crores for international universities. Includes pre-visa sanction letters, I-20 financial proof of funds, Canadian GIC account funding (CAD 20,635), and German Sperrkonto / Blocked Account financing (€11,904).
- [Domestic Education Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/domestic-loans.html): Comprehensive financing for premier Indian institutions including IITs, IIMs, NITs, BITS, and accredited central/private universities covering 100% of tuition fees, accommodation, books, and laptops.
- [MBBS Education Loans](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/mbbs-loans.html): Specialized medical degree financing for MBBS in India (government and private medical colleges) and MBBS Abroad (Russia, Philippines, Uzbekistan, Georgia, Europe, Central Asia) with flexible moratorium tenures.
- [Other Loans & Forex](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/other-loans.html): Advisory support for personal loans, home loans, and loan against property (LAP) to support related educational and relocation needs.
- [Partner Lenders](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/partner-lenders.html): Official partnership network of 15+ leading financial institutions including Public Sector Banks (SBI, Bank of Baroda, PNB, Canara Bank, Union Bank), Private Banks (ICICI Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank, Axis Bank), and leading NBFCs (HDFC Credila, Avanse, Auxilo, InCred, Tata Capital, Poonawalla Fincorp).
- [Partner With Us](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/partner-with-us.html): Dedicated partner portal for study abroad education consultants, test prep academies, and university agents across India.

## Country Guides & Visa Requirements
- [Study in USA](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/usa.html): Loans up to ₹2 Cr, STEM OPT 3-year work extension guidance, I-20 funding proof, non-collateral options up to ₹75 Lakhs.
- [Study in UK](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/uk.html): Russell Group university funding, 1-year Master's financing, CAS deposit support, UKVI 28-day fund rule compliance, 2-year Graduate Route visa.
- [Study in Canada](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/canada.html): SDS visa support, tuition fee plus direct GIC account funding (CAD 20,635), PGWP work permits up to 3 years.
- [Study in Germany](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/germany.html): Public university zero tuition support, Sperrkonto (German Blocked Account €11,904) financing, 18-month Jobseeker visa.
- [Study in Australia](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/australia.html): Group of Eight (Go8) university funding, Genuine Student (GS) assessment compliance, OSHC health cover.
- [Study in Ireland](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/ireland.html): European Silicon Valley tech hub education financing, 1-year Master's programs, 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa.
- [Study in France](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/france.html): Grandes Écoles, MBA & English-taught programs, Campus France financial verification, CAF housing assistance.
- [Study in New Zealand](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/new-zealand.html): British-style degree programs, ANZ Bank Funds Transfer Scheme (FTS - NZD 20,000) funding, post-study work visa up to 3 years.
- [Study in Dubai (UAE)](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/dubai.html): International branch campuses (Heriot-Watt, Wollongong, BITS, SP Jain), rapid student visa processing, tax-free earnings.
- [Study Across Europe](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/countries/europe.html): Netherlands, Sweden, Italy, Spain, Switzerland; multi-currency financing and Schengen visa fund compliance.

## Knowledge & Educational Resources
- [Financial Calculators Suite](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/calculators.html): Interactive 5-tool financial suite including moratorium-aware Education Loan EMI calculator, Study Abroad Currency Planner, Loan Refinancing Takeover Savings calculator, Section 80E Tax Rebate tool, and Profile Loan Eligibility checker.
- [Education Loan Blog Hub](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/blog.html): Comprehensive banking analyses, CIBIL eligibility guides, policy breakdowns, and financial tools.
- [CIBIL Score for Education Loans Guide](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/blogs/how-does-cibil-score-affect-your-education-loan.html): Detailed analysis of credit bureau scores, public vs private bank cutoff criteria, co-applicant evaluation rules, and low CIBIL solutions.
- [Collateral vs Non-Collateral Loans Guide](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/blogs/collateral-vs-non-collateral-education-loan.html): Detailed comparison of secured vs unsecured education loans, ₹75 Lakh limits, property eligibility, and interest calculations.
- [Education Loans for Study in USA Guide](https://www.visionarypathservices.com/pages/blogs/education-loan-for-study-in-usa.html): Complete guide to I-20 proof of funds, pre-visa bank sanction letters, INR vs USD loans, and STEM OPT repayment models.

## Key Student Benefits
1. **Unbiased Multi-Lender Comparison:** Compare interest rates, processing fees, margin money, and repayment moratoriums across 15+ lenders.
2. **Pre-Visa Sanction Letters:** Fast-track sanction letters required for visa filing and university admissions.
3. **No Service Charges:** 100% free counseling for students.
4. **End-to-End Assistance:** From initial profile assessment and document preparation to bank sanction and loan disbursement.
